description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Creates a new brand in the account owner's organization, the same as "New brand" in the dashboard. Send `name` and optionally `website`, like `{ name: "Dragon Shop", website: "https://shop.example.com" }`. Only an ACCOUNT-WIDE connection with the write scope can do this; a connection bound to one brand gets 403. The plan's brand limit applies: at the limit the call is a 402 and nothing is created (relay the message). Optional `profile`, `voice`, `colors` and `fonts` (the brand_profile_update shapes) and `logoStorageId` (an image from upload_media) are saved in the same call. Pass `orgId` only when a 422 with code ORG_REQUIRED lists more than one organization. Creates a brand, never an API key; every create is audited against this connection.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/brands.)

colors.description: REPLACES the brand palette, the same as saving Brand → Overview → Brand Colors: the stored list is primary, secondary, then palette (duplicates dropped); primary and secondary are its top two. 6-digit hex, `#` optional, stored lower case.

fonts.description: Font family names. A role left out keeps its stored font. At least one is required.

logoStorageId.description: A storageId from POST /api/v2/media/upload-url (an image). It becomes the brand's primary logo.

name.description: The brand name. Must not match another active brand in the organization.

orgId.description: The organization to create in. Needed only when the key owner belongs to more than one: without it the call is a 422 (code ORG_REQUIRED) that lists them.

profile.description: Only the fields sent are changed. Unknown fields are a 422.

voice.description: The brand default voice. Created (as the default) when the brand has none.

website.description: The brand's website. Shortcut for profile.website.

name: create_brand
title: Create a brand
